snippet.title: Mayak Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
A hand-painted sci-fi adventure about first contact, love, and the unknown. Inspired by classic hard science fiction, Mayak delivers a focused narrative journey toward a single unforgettable conclusion.

Developed and published by Nikita Nplus1.
